subject.title: [Bug]: Hundreds of repeated HTTP requests to 169.254.169.254:80 for the first 10 minutes after the startup

question: Should Bedrock memory auto-detection suppress IMDS/default-chain probing when no explicit AWS credential signal is present, while preserving explicit Bedrock SDK credential flows?
rationale: The fix boundary affects both sandbox metadata-service safety and AWS auth-provider compatibility, so automation should not choose the permanent credential behavior by itself.

options.title: Land a Bedrock-local no-signal guard
options.body: Prevent auto-detection from reaching IMDS unless a Bedrock/AWS credential signal or explicit provider configuration makes the SDK chain intentional.

options.title: Preserve current SDK-chain behavior
options.body: Keep IMDS probing available during auto-detection, accepting the sandbox log/security noise as the cost of broad AWS SDK discovery.

options.title: Require stronger live proof first
options.body: Hold the issue and linked PR until maintainers have both non-AWS sandbox proof and EC2/ECS/default-chain credential proof.

recommendation.title: Land a Bedrock-local no-signal guard
recommendation.body: Prevent auto-detection from reaching IMDS unless a Bedrock/AWS credential signal or explicit provider configuration makes the SDK chain intentional.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin adapter boundary and recent Bedrock memory credential-gate commit are in steipete's history, making this the best available routing owner.
